current: Nothing reads the key and nothing could render it. `grep -rain -e '"statusLine"' -e "'statusLine'" -e 'statusLine:' -e 'statusline' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.json' packages apps` returns exactly two hits, both `packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:901-902`, a local in a `**Status:**` plan-markdown parser — so there is also no `/statusline` command and no `subagentStatusLine`. `StoredConfig` (packages/shared/src/config/storage.ts:51), the `~/.nessy-agent/config.json` shape where this fork mirrors `settings.md` keys (`askUserQuestionTimeout` :102, `sandbox` :105, `worktree` :108, `workflow` :113, `sessionMirror` :117), has no `statusLine` member. The Claude settings files are write-only for us and only for permissions: packages/shared/src/agent/claude-settings-store.ts:92 `claudeSettingsPath` resolves the three destinations and :119 `addClaudePermissionRules` is an additive permissions-only merger. The user scope is deliberately out of reach — packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:203-206 records that `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is redirected per Workspace so "a hand-written `~/.claude/settings.json` stops reaching the subprocess" (`workspaceClaudeConfigDir`, options.ts:221), and packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:2994 states in shipped source "we have no reader for `~/.claude/settings.json`". Project/local settings do reach the Claude Agent SDK subprocess (packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:305, `settingSources: ['user', 'project', 'local']`), but that subprocess is headless and has no channel by which status-line text could reach our renderer. No surface exists to render one: the only status-shaped element is `ToolbarStatusSlot` (apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/ToolbarStatusSlot.tsx:35-112), an `absolute inset-0` overlay with exactly two hard-coded states — the escape-to-interrupt hint (:74-101) and the browser-session banner (:103-109) — consumed once from apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/FreeFormInput.tsx:76; and apps/cli is a thin websocket client (apps/cli/package.json declares only `@nessy-agent/shared` and `@nessy-agent/server-core`, no ink or TUI renderer) with no footer. The fork also has no vim mode at all (`grep -rain 'vimMode|vim-mode' apps/electron/src packages/shared/src` → 0 hits), so `hideVimModeIndicator` and `vim.mode` have no counterpart to suppress or report. Two mechanisms a build would reuse already exist and are wired to nothing here: `runHookCommand` (packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts:653-794) already spawns a shell command with a JSON payload on stdin (`child.stdin?.end(hookCommandStdinPayload(...))`, :737), caps output and does SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL on timeout (:742-748); and `parseAnsi`/`stripAnsi` (packages/ui/src/components/terminal/ansi-parser.ts:58 and :120) already render ANSI spans in the renderer. On the plugin path, a plugin-root `settings.json` is deferred wholesale — the last row of `CLAUDE_RETAINED_SURFACE_FIELDS` (packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275) feeding `addClaudeRetainedSurfaceDeferrals` (:2278-2317), which pushes a `deferred` row and interprets no keys.
divergence: Whole-mechanism absence, in three independent layers, not a key-name or value-shape mismatch: (1) no settings key — `statusLine` is absent from `StoredConfig` and from every validator, and the `.claude/settings.json` files Claude documents are never read by us at all (user scope redirected away, project/local only forwarded to a headless SDK subprocess); (2) no runner — nothing builds the `:169-208` stdin payload, exports `COLUMNS`/`LINES`, honours `refreshInterval` (min 1) or `padding` (default 0), and nothing implements the `:141-151` trigger set with its 300 ms debounce and cancel-in-flight; (3) no surface — no row above the composer badges that can display command stdout, multi-line or ANSI-colored. `hideVimModeIndicator` and the payload's `vim.mode` are additionally moot because the fork has no vim mode. NOT part of this divergence, per the surviving challenge: a plugin-shipped top-level `statusLine` is inert in Claude Code too (plugins.md:298 supports only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` in a plugin-root `settings.json`), so the blanket plugin-settings deferral at format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 costs us those two keys (f053, f206) and not this one — do not "fix" f205 inside the plugin adapter.

change.what: NEW module, following the shape of its siblings `sandbox-settings.ts` / `worktree-settings.ts` / `workflow-settings.ts`. Type: `{ type: 'command'; command: string; padding?: number; refreshInterval?: number; hideVimModeIndicator?: boolean }`. Normalizer: accept only `type: 'command'` (any other value = whole setting dropped), require a non-empty `command`, default `padding` to 0 (statusline.md:67), and drop `refreshInterval` values below 1 rather than clamping silently (`:69` "The minimum is `1`"). `hideVimModeIndicator` is parsed and inert — record in the module comment that this fork has no vim-mode indicator to suppress, so the field is accepted for file portability only.

Add `statusLine?: StatusLineSettingsV1;` next to the other mirrored `settings.md` groups (`sandbox` :105, `worktree` :108, `workflow` :113). One line plus the import. This is the persisted `~/.nessy-agent/config.json` shape — additive-optional, so no migration, but see blastRadius.

Validate the new key so a malformed `statusLine` is reported rather than silently dropped: non-`'command'` type, missing/empty `command`, non-integer `padding`, `refreshInterval < 1`. Mirror how the existing per-group settings are validated in this file.

NEW module — the runner. Copy the spawn mechanism verbatim in spirit from packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts:707-793 (shell spawn, `stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']`, `child.stdin?.on('error')` guard then `child.stdin?.end(payload)`, capped stdout, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after a grace window) and add the three things a status line needs that a hook does not: `COLUMNS`/`LINES` in the child env (statusline.md:163), a 300 ms debounce that CANCELS the in-flight child on a new trigger (`:151`), and the optional `refreshInterval` timer (`:69`, `:147`). `statusLineStdinPayload` emits the snake_case shape of `:169-208`; fields with no source in this fork (`cost.total_cost_usd` and the rest of `cost.*`, `rate_limits.*`, `vim.mode`, `pr.*`, `worktree.*`, `fast_mode`, `effort.level`) must be OMITTED rather than zero-filled — the page documents them as absent when unavailable, and a fabricated `0` cost reads as "this session was free". Available sources: `ContextUsageSnapshot` (packages/core/src/types/message.ts:601) supplies `modelId`, `inputTokens`, `contextWindow` and `percent` for `model.id` and `context_window.*`; the session record supplies `session_id`, `transcript_path` and `cwd`.

Own the scheduler in the main process (it is the process that already spawns child commands) and push rendered text to the renderer over a new IPC channel exposed through the preload bridge as `window.electronAPI.statusLine`. Fire on the documented triggers only (statusline.md:141-147): session start incl. resume, new assistant message, `/compact` completion, permission-mode change, refresh timer. Drop the vim-mode trigger — no vim mode exists here.

NEW component: a row rendered ABOVE the existing composer badges, never replacing them (statusline.md:18). Split stdout on newlines into rows (`:157`), colorize with the existing `parseAnsi` (packages/ui/src/components/terminal/ansi-parser.ts:58) rather than a new parser, apply `padding` as extra horizontal indent (`:67`), and render nothing at all when the command is unset, errored or produced empty output. Mount it in apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/FreeFormInput.tsx beside the existing `ToolbarStatusSlot` import at :76 — it is a sibling row, not a new state of that overlay, whose two states (escape hint, browser banner) must keep their current priority.

Suppress the status line under safe mode. `env-vars.md:318` names the status line among the surfaces `CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE=1` must not load, and docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:448 already records that line as only partly met precisely because we had no such surface. Building one creates the obligation; a status line is a user-authored shell command, which is exactly what safe mode exists to stop.

blastRadius: Crosses a persistence boundary and an IPC/wire boundary — both named risk triggers in AGENTS.md. Persistence: `StoredConfig` is `~/.nessy-agent/config.json`, read and written by packages/shared/src/config/storage.ts and re-read on change by packages/shared/src/config/watcher.ts (which already watches `config.json`, watcher.ts:431-432); the managed-policy layer (config/managed-*.ts, config-doctor.ts, managed-drops.ts) enumerates StoredConfig keys, so a new key must decide explicitly whether an administrator may drop or force it. Wire: renderer delivery needs a new Electron IPC channel plus a preload surface, and if it should also work for remote/mirrored workspaces it needs an RPC in packages/server-core — a status line for a remote session either runs the command locally against remote data or does not exist, and that choice must be recorded. Execution: it adds a NEW local shell-execution path outside the tool-permission funnel, so safe mode (see the change list) and the sandbox posture both have a say; it must never be spawned from a project-scoped file without the same trust posture the rest of the repo applies, because `.claude/settings.json` is checked in and an inline `command` there is arbitrary code from a cloned repository. Renderer: apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/FreeFormInput.tsx is a large, heavily shared composer file — zone the work by file per AGENTS.md, and the composer is a playground design surface, so all playground composer states need sweeping for the new row. Reuse points that gain a second consumer: packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.ts (mechanism copied, not called — do not widen `runHookCommand`'s hook-shaped signature to serve this) and packages/ui/src/components/terminal/ansi-parser.ts. Tests: none exist for any of this; packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.test.ts is the model for the runner, and the plugin-adapter tests are NOT affected — nothing in packages/shared/src/plugins should change for f205.
userImpact: None observable in normal use, and silently wrong for one concrete action: a user who follows statusline.md — writes `~/.claude/settings.json` or the project `.claude/settings.json` with a `statusLine` block, or runs `/statusline show model name and context percentage` — gets nothing. No row appears above the composer, no error, no diagnostic, and no 'unknown setting' notice, because the user-scope file is never read (the config dir is redirected per Workspace, options.ts:203-206) and `/statusline` is not a command in this fork. The composer's bottom row stays limited to its built-in elements — model picker, permission-mode picker, context badge, and the two `ToolbarStatusSlot` states — so persistent git branch, session cost, or any custom segment cannot be surfaced at all. It would become visible the moment a Claude Code user migrates a settings.json into Nessy, or a team ships a repo whose `.claude/settings.json` carries a status line their onboarding docs describe.
